item.title: Gabriel Abrantes: Bardo Loops
item.description: Gasworks presents Bardo Loops, the first UK solo exhibition by artist and filmmaker Gabriel Abrantes. An installation presented over four screens, the work portrays two animated ghosts variously arguing, reconciling, and singing laments. Blending wry, ironic humour with overt melodrama, the dialogue blends autobiographical fragments from Gabriel’s own life withbroader themes such as climate change
